map.24K 只是理论 100%，实际足金多为 999‰ 或 999.9‰；14K 理: 24K is only a theoretical 100%; real fine gold is usually 999‰ or 999.9‰. 14K is theoretically about 583.3‰ but is customarily stamped 585‰. Confirm jewellery purity from the hallmark and an assay.
map.理论上 24K 等于 1000‰，但实际不存在绝对纯金：国标规定足金不低于 99: Theoretically 24K is 1000‰, but absolute pure gold does not exist in practice. The standard sets fine gold at not less than 990‰, and most “24K” on the market is 999‰ or 999.9‰, so the table gives theoretical values; check the hallmark and assay. 1K is about 1000÷24 = 41.667‰, hence 18K = 750‰ and 14K = 583‰ (commonly stamped 585).
